verdict.rationale: A hardware security-key vendor could plausibly ship official SDKs, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no Feitian SDK. The evidence instead shows end-user management tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool), compliance with the standard WebAuthn protocol, and the option to build Google's third-party OpenSK firmware onto Feitian hardware. None of these is an official SDK to build against, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
